goal: Prevent Tor control authentication failures when passwords contain backslashes
Ensure node operators with complex Tor passwords can set up hidden services reliably
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Prefers hex-encoding over escaping per Tor spec and favors it over #36374 (winterrdog)
Verified against the Tor control spec documentation (vasild)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes Tor control authentication failures for passwords with backslashes
Affects only nodes using a custom Tor control password containing backslashes
